description: Creation of a vehicle crossover and retrospective application for boundary fences to front of the house, front hardstanding, new gate to side access, rear boundary fence and a raised rear patio area.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (5127(5)DT302, 5127(5)DT303, 5127(5)EL003, 5127(5)EL004, 5127(5)LP001 Rev. B, 5127(5)SP003 Rev. C, 5127(5)SP004 Rev. A, 5127(5)SP005. Received: 10/02/2020. Design & Access Statement 7 February 2020. Received: 25/02/2020) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - A splay of 2.4m x 2.4m shall be provided on each side of the access, the depth measured from the back of the footway and the widths outwards from the edges of the access, and no fence, wall or other obstruction to visibility exceeding 0.6m in height above the surface of the adjoining highway shall be erected or allowed to grow within the areas of these splays on land within the approved development site.
Condition : 4 - A low wall or fence, not exceeding 600mm in height, shall be retained directly on either side of the vehicular access as shown on drawing number 5127(5)SP003 Rev C.
